items.title: Albuquerque Bitcoin, Crypto ATM Ban Takes Effect With $500 Daily Fines
items.summary: Albuquerque's ban on crypto ATMs and cashier-facilitated cryptocurrency transactions has taken effect, exposing noncompliant businesses to financial penalties and possible closure. items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Erase October Losses With $1 Billion in Three Days
items.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs have drawn about $1.07 billion over three sessions, pushing October flows to a gain of roughly $460 million, even as Bitcoin and Ethereum prices slipped.

items.title: Bitcoin circles $81.5K ETF cost basis as Trump Iran comments send stocks lower

items.title: Robinhood Wins Dubai License to Bring Bitcoin and Stock Trading to the Middle East in 2027
items.summary: Robinhood has won DFSA approval to offer bitcoin, crypto and stock trading with custody from a new Dubai headquarters, with launch set for 2027. This post Robinhood Wins Dubai License to Bring Bitcoin and Stock Trading to the Middle East in 2027 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
